description: Client for the most used Experian UK APIs (not every Experian service): Delphi Select (credit search, Identity Authenticate / AuthPlus, Detect, Affordability), KYC and PEP/sanctions, PowerCurve Customer Acquisition, Work Report, NED and IDP.
releaseNotes:
v1.0.1:
- ADDED: CreditFileSignals.ofOutput / currentInstructions: summary flags, special instructions with dates, Notices of Correction and the applicant's CIFAS markers
- ADDED: CreditAccount.SpecialInstruction
- ADDED: AuthPlus.ofOutput / ofResults: decision, authentication index, confirmed level and high-risk rules per applicant
- ADDED: PublicRecords.impairedCredit / ofOutput / unsatisfied: bankruptcy, IVA, CCJ band and arrears per applicant; public records
- ADDED: Affordability.ofOutput: CATO income estimates, income verification and debt-to-income ratios
- ADDED: KycOutcome.ofResponse: overall KYC or PEP/sanctions decision, reasons, next actions and fired rules per service
v1.0.0:
- ADDED: generated clients for Delphi Select v2.5, KYC and PEP/sanctions, PowerCurve Customer Acquisition v1.21, Work Report, NED and IDP, each with its own types
- ADDED: Api modules with Task/Result calls per product, including Delphi Select AuthPlus (in an application, second phase, stand-alone)
- ADDED: OAuth password-flow token cache shared by all products; renews a minute before expiry, one fetch for concurrent callers, one retry on 401
- ADDED: Endpoints.sandbox / production; ExperianClient over a caller-owned HttpMessageHandler
- ADDED: Webhook.verify for IDP X-HMAC-SHA256-Signature deliveries
- ADDED: bundled specs edited for SwaggerProvider 4.2.1: amounts as double, quoted numeric enums, Delphi view flags as strings, Work Report discriminator, PowerCurve examples and reference name clashes
- ADDED: bundled specs corrected to the sandbox's answers: KYC missing fields and dates, NED list, IDP event types, Work Report postCode, PowerCurve two-digit-year dates
- ADDED: lenient response reading: unquoted strings, quoted numbers, "" and "-" as None, case-insensitive names, double-encoded bodies
- ADDED: JSON sent as application/json without charset (the gateway refuses charset=utf-8)
- ADDED: Api.WorkReport.requestReportAsync returns the report PDF bytes
- ADDED: string path parameters are escaped as one segment; empty, "." and ".." are InvalidRequest and not sent
- ADDED: Credentials and AccessToken print without the password, client secret or token
- ADDED: SearchType (Quotation = soft footprint, CreditApplication = hard, OtherSearch), Api.DelphiSelect.setSearchType and convertQuoteAsync
- ADDED: CreditAccounts.ofOutput / amountOwed / outstanding / totalOwed: typed credit accounts and the applicant's debt list from Delphi Select, defaults at their current default balance
